scenes.vo: Last night I learned Halden Building has eight floors. And I was standing on the ninth.
So I ran. Down the stairs, two at a time. Eight. Seven. Six. Then the next sign said NINE.
I tried again, and again. Every flight down led me back to the same green hallway. The same red DOOR.
So I called the elevator. Something heavy came climbing up the shaft. The doors slid open. Above the eight, there was a new button. NINE. It was already lit.
I pressed one. The doors closed, and we went down. For a long, long TIME.
Then the doors opened to my own front door. Someone was knocking on it. From INSIDE.
